newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nth Flinders sees 95/96 hard to better.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nth Flinders sees 95/96 hard to better.

text.p: North Flinders Mines Ltd executive chairman Tony Palmer said on Thursday the company was unlikely to be able to improve on 1995/96 gold production in 1996/97.

"I think we would expect our production to be 220,000 ounces-plus again at the end of the year," Palmer told reporters after the company's annual meeting. "I think we wouldn't expect to do any better than last year's results because our ounces were roughly the same," he said.
North Flinders, currently under takeover by Normandy Mining Ltd, produced 225,748 ounces of gold in 1995/96.

When asked if North Flinder's net profit would be flat around last year's A$35.6 million result, Palmer said: "I'm not here to tell you what I think it is going to be. What I'm telling you is our production will be roughly four times what it was the first quarter."

North Flinders said earlier unaudited net profit in the first quarter ended September 30 fell to A$7.09 million from A$7.99 million a year earlier, while gold production was 56,161 ounces, compared with 53,729 ounces in the June quarter.
Normandy has 73.7 percent of North Flinders' issued capital. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
